svg.text: Hypothesis: a stack of ruled boxes (one per question group) beats a long single form; the label tabs do the grouping, so there are no cards.
Anchors: Mundial desktop (ruled 1px boxes), Paperless Post (invite as a physical object), Premier League (tabular numerals) from references/rsvp-save-the-date-sports-ticket-2026-10-14.md.
Commitments: names side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile; conditional fields (plus-one name, other sport, WhatsApp number) appear from their toggle, dashed here; "optional" tags, no asterisks.
Flag: the brief never lists an Email field for this view, but the code is sent to it, so the wireframe adds it in CONTACT.
Frames are extended past the fold (900 / 844) to show the whole scroll. Submit label and field labels are the agreed control labels, not final marketing copy.
